title: Hexmaker: tag every input and picker (round 6, SP3, tree view)
lead: Every user-facing input, picker, button, command and menu item on `feat/region-notes`, as a tree: **screen › section › item**. Pick once for a whole screen or section, or open it and pick items one by one. Your 65 picks so far are kept as they were. Submit any time.

tiers.label: Keep (as today)
tiers.desc: Whatever it does today, unchanged, including its feature switch or greyed-out rules. Feature switches that ramp Simple users up are keep.

tiers.label: Simple (show to everyone)
tiers.desc: Shown at every level. **Simple stays customizable**: palettes and palette management, look and feel, and defaults lean here.

tiers.label: Advanced (hide from Simple)
tiers.desc: A real extra feature, or an option of one. When unsure between Advanced and Overkill, pick Advanced.

tiers.label: Overkill ("All" level only)
tiers.desc: Backend-fiddler stuff: engine tuning, raw seeds and ids, maintenance and diagnostics. Shown only at the new All level.

tiers.label: Drop entirely
tiers.desc: Redundant or dead; removed at every level.

overkill: shown, with a "you probably don't need these" caveat

facts: **Legacy (pre-1.13)** items in Settings are the fallback copies of the same settings. Each follows its twin; you tagged them before twins existed, so they show as overrides. Use "Follow twin" on a row, or the filter "Twins picked differently", to line them up.
Blue chip: when the item shows today. Red **mixed list** chip: a picker that lists unrelated kinds of note.
Full inventory with reasons and line numbers: KB note `projects/duckmage-plugin/notes/impl/audit-inputs-2026-10-11`.
